content: Human-labeling session — econ-multi-patch-allocation:easy seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a multi-patch allocation mission. You hold a Construction Yard (fact) and a Power Plant (powr) at your home base in the west, with $1500 in the bank. Four ore patches are visible, each with a pre-positioned idle harvester (harv, an unarmed ore-collector truck) waiting beside it: a small near patch A at (20,20) that drains fast, two medium patches B at (40,8) and C at (40,32), and a rich far patch D at (115,20) whose round-trip dominates throughput. A harvester only deposits when an Ore Refinery (proc) exists. Within about 40 turns, own at least two refineries and finish with cash at least $4500.
